description: Upload a file and attach it to a work item. The file is read from the local filesystem, uploaded to Azure DevOps, and linked to the specified work item.

fileName.description: The name to use for the attachment. If not provided, the name will be extracted from the file path.

filePath.description: The absolute path to the file to upload as an attachment

workItemId.description: The ID of the work item to attach the file to

name: create_work_item_attachment
